pr_title: ADR-0083 DENY + M-CC-P10 pipeline maturity + CLI canonicalization
summary: F8 observability/operations review for PR #3: pipeline maturity improved surface-all-failures, but review/fix-loop telemetry still has fail-open and ephemeral-evidence gaps; 3 actionable findings, highest severity MAJOR.

findings.issue: Reviewer dispatch is triggered by each individual successful workflow_run for pr-tests or supply-chain, but the job condition checks only the triggering run. It does not verify that all required upstream checks converged green for the same head SHA before review starts.
findings.remediation: Resolve the PR head SHA, query the branch-protection/Check Runs API for every required context, and fail closed unless all required contexts are successful for that SHA.

findings.issue: The workflow invokes the dispatcher in its default external mode and never fails the job when subagent_runtime_pending is true. With missing/incomplete facet evidence, the dispatcher can still write an APPROVE-shaped rollup/admission event while marking the panel pending.
findings.remediation: Run the inline review runtime or pre-materialize the full facet panel, and make the workflow fail closed on subagent_runtime_pending=true before writing merge-queue admission.

findings.issue: The fix-loop assembles context bundles and failed-job summaries inside the ephemeral CI workspace but the workflow has no always-upload artifact step for those bundles. Non-escalated failure context can be lost after the runner exits, weakening incident diagnosability.
findings.remediation: Always upload the generated fix-loop bundle directory, failed-jobs.tsv, and retry-budget registry as workflow artifacts with PR/head-SHA naming and retention.
